youtube-mcp.description: Upload videos, set thumbnails, fetch analytics for BankingExpertRam channel

gdrive-mcp.description: Sync output_v19/ videos and script_editor.xlsx to Google Drive

notes.client_secrets: Download OAuth2 credentials from Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials. Save as client_secrets.json in project root. Set YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRETS_FILE=client_secrets.json in .env
notes.gdrive_folder_id: Get the folder ID from the Drive URL: drive.google.com/drive/folders/<FOLDER_ID>. Set GDRIVE_FOLDER_ID in .env
notes.first_run: Each server will open a browser window for OAuth2 login on first run. Tokens are cached in mcp/configs/youtube_token.json and gdrive_token.json
